reviews.text: At westwood vets staff are wonderful, polite, knowledgeable, professional and very happy to assist you with any problem or query you have.
You always get great service from Westwood vets and they do care for your pets as if they are there own pets
We have been going to this practice for years. They are friendly, helpful and nothing is too much bother for them.
Really friendly and helpful people. I can always get an appointment when I need one. They send helpful reminders about regular medication too.

Winnie has her anal glands emptied every 6 weeks with Becky - even though she hates having them done she is always pleased to see Becky.  Becky is always smiley, efficient & great at her job. Thank you ❤️

I took Jerry for his 6 month check up. Not only did they manage to fit him in that afternoon but the vet nurse we saw was great. She was very friendly and informative and she obviously loved animals. Westwood vets have always been brilliant. I would highly recommend them.
Always 1st class
Staff very friendly and helpful

Always helpful
Really friendly staff very knowledgeable
Always a top service, friendly vets, friendly staff, my dog loves going (I think it's the gravy bones). Couldn't be more grateful and lucky to have them as my local vet
Great friendly team. Goodnrwnge of services. Professional operation. I would recommend. Efficient at processing the insurance claim

I have used Westwood Vets for all 3 of my pets (1 dog, 2 cats) for the last 11 years. The staff are always friendly and attentive. I always feel like my animals are in great care when we have to visit the vets and they really do love and care for every animal
All staff are always so kind and helpful, they’re amazing with our over excitable and noisy dog! We’ve been with them for nearly 20 years and couldn’t recommend them more!
Fantastic vets brilliant receptionists

I’ve used Westwood vets since adopting my dog Smudge. We’ve visited several times for check up and routine need eg nail clipping.

Yesterday we had an emergency where a grass seed got stuck in Smudge’s eye and I couldn’t get it out. I phoned them and they were able to fit us in immediately. The vets were so kind, patient and gentle with Smudge and managed to get not just 1 but 2 seeds out from his eye. They then proceed to check him over for seeds everywhere else and then washed his eyes out with saline solution just to be on the safe side.

As a pet owner you want vets you can trust that will take your concerns seriously and make sure your pet is as healthy as possible. Westwood vets have done that for me and Smudge. Would highly recommend

The receptionists and vets are very friendly, knowledgeable and caring whilst remaining professional, there is a separate seating area for cats/small animals and it is always kept very clean and tidy.
The best vets, the care for my 3 cats over the past 18 months has been amazing. Cant recommend enough

Really friendly and pleasant reception staff and vet. Kind and listened, fully explained the process. Bonus first visit free just paid for meds!! Joined the Pet Care club for discounts and free consultation etc.
The reception staff were very attentive with me and my cats. The nurse explained everything she was doing l found this helpful. Extremely satisfied with the whole practice.
I would recommend you to all my friends who have pets such nice people
Helpful, friendly and informative staff

Took us a while to find a perfect vet practice after changing a few times. But we found a treasure here at Westwood and are very lucky to have such a wonderful team looking after our Chewy Louie !!! Also, Can’t recommend the pet club here enough, It brings peace of mind when needing a consultation, if moneys a bit tight and you get a good package for the monthly payments 🐶🐶🐶
We love this vets so friendly staff and always clean and tidy even Toby the doggy likes to go
Lovely, caring, personable ladies! Very patient with my American bully cross and bunny rabbits over the last 7 years . Thank you ever so much
Great vet practice. Very friendly staff great with my dog. They keep me up to date with meds to be given ie wormer flea. Great when needing an appointments 👍 …

We joined this vet this year and the service so far has been excellent. The staff are always really friendly and polite and they put our dog at ease whenever we visit. He had an operation recently and it all went smoothly. They kept us up to date with how he was doing as we were anxious about him and booked all his aftercare in for us.

We have been going to Westwood Vets since taking on our first  foster dog in November last year and they have been wonderful. Very kind and caring both the reception team and the vets and nurses. A 10/10 from Lovely Lola Long Legs
Great vets. Took an injured stray in for an emergency appointment. Staff were all very friendly. And a fantastic vet. Already in process to register my new cat with them. 10/10

I have a very nervous,snappy dog who objects to examination. The vet listened to my concerns before the examination and acted accordingly. He explained everything in detail and discussed the best options for treatment.
Very friendly staff always helpful and brilliant with my very crazy dog who can't stay still while they give her a check over always patient and have plenty of treats on hand

We've been with westwood vets for about 20 years they are always friendly welcoming, they are so professional they have always been excellent with all my pets we even have a very dog aggressive boy and they go above and beyond with their help and welfare of Brian so everyone mainly other dogs are safe
Fabulous place
Great vets. Friendly and took time with Hudson’s check up
Exceptional service, put both our dog’s at ease never seen spaniels so chilled, and they love the treats at the end.

Nice vet practice, kind and helpful, the best veterinary service we have used so far, the vets approach the pet with commitment.
Very happy with them
Brilliant staff, very friendly and helpful. The vet I saw was gentle and attentive to my cat Kylie .

Have used this practice for a very long time, and over the years they have cared for the four different pairs of dogs I've shared my life with during that time.

I have always found them to be friendly, caring, and professional.
All the vets are very caring and this is demonstrated during visits. They were really supportive when we had to have one of our cats put to sleep unexpectedly
Lovely friendly surgery with super helpful and knowledgeable staff

From the moment you arrive to leaving everyone is very helpful, informative,  caring, pleasant and understanding.
A very really lovely professional team.
100% Satisfied with my experiences.
My Boston Stevie LOVES this place. They have been amazing with her, especially after helping herself to some wild garlic and cheese scones. Quick advice over the phone as always.

Nice vets
Gave cats injections
Great friendly practice, always helpful with advice and always easy to get an appointment.

I have to say this day and age ,with no price list ,and a monopoly of the prices, a small dog which is a sad occasion to be put down, 2 small injections and  a price of £220 is very steep,you could probably check around but I think it would be the same in the Vets conglomerate

Avoid at all costs! My Daxie was having difficulty walking suggested it was a spinal condition, after multiple visits and continuous charges for prescriptions I was around £1000 down and still no answers. I suggested it could be Lyme disease early on after my own research as she had been bitten by a tic a month prior, they basically said not a chance (they also said it was normal for her temp to be running high, the specialist I saw after them looked at me funny when I told them this) its now been tested and diagnosed 4 months down the line with her in crippling pain. After getting no where I went to another vets, they did more in 1 visit than these did in 4 and charged less. Shouldn’t be allowed to happen, they have a prescription culture and have no drive to solve a problem, but instead upselling it and keep medicating to increase sales. I was told at one point we might just have to ‘deal with it’ using pain meds not even knowing what it was!

Saying goodbye to our beloved dog, Lola, was one of the hardest moments for our family. The entire team showed such kindness, understanding, and genuine compassion during this incredibly painful time. They treated Lola with dignity and gave us the space and support we needed to say our goodbyes.

Although this was an awful process to go through, the staff made it as gentle and comforting as it possibly could be. We are truly grateful for their empathy and care
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts 💕

Hazel and the rest of the reception staff as well as the vets are always friendly as well as professional. They always look after our cats with care and affection.
I feel that the nurse yesterday went above and beyond during the consultation. She thoroughly checked the cats over, allowed my son to listen to their heartbeats and even used the clippers to remove some clumps from Tikka’s fur. She was so polite and professional. We were also recommended powder for suspected in Arthritis which I’ve now ordered for Tikka. We can’t thank her enough 😊
Our 3rd visit here. Staff are friendly and professional.  I feel happy with the service here. No issues and it seems easy enough to get appointments.
Amazing staff! Very polite, friendly, and professional. There are vets much closer to us, but it’s worth travelling to Westoods for the service they provide.
A very clean, well organised and professional vet's, clearly explaining what's been done.
Used Westwood vets today and as always fantastic service

Our appointment was 30 minutes late with no explanation, so our cats were stressing for well over an hour including the car trip. Also the prices have massively increased by about 25% since last year and the clinician attempted to add more to that amount by recommending an extra vaccination that our cats have never had before in their 13 years.
Everyone was very friendly and the clinician was helpful but the prices are getting to the point where we will not be able to afford getting our cats vaccinated any more.

Friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Very good vets and nurses and  always explain what and why they are doing to my dogs. I would definitely use them.

I have never had a bad visit. The staff are kind, thoughtful, attentive and listen to my obsessive dog mum nonsense! Although my dogs are not fans of the vet visits, the staff put them at ease and treat them beautifully.
Been going to Westwood vets more than 10 years. The staff are always welcoming and listen to any issues I have and treat accordingly
Just such a lovely practice. Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a new or change of vets

I’ve been with west woods vets for a few years now,  I have two French bulldogs and I can honestly say from making appointments over the phone to attending appointments and walking through the door to seeing the vets is absolutely brilliant. You are listened to, reception are so lovely, and the vets are brilliant with my dogs. I would highly recommend this practice. All of the staff are brilliant.

This is purely the best vets in town. They look after my elderly rag doll Valentino, who had a bad experience at a previous vets. They go the extra mile for him and have kept notes even down to scent cats love and are sure to have it on there hands when they see him. They are so caring and patient with him. I have also just adapted a dog that I found dancing in the traffic, they helped me with checking him over and what to do. They now have him on their records and have welcomed him with open arms that he loves to see them.  He is all chipped vaccinated n ready to love life. Thank you all at Westwood Vets, Garforth. You are all amazing.
We have come to this vet for a long time and we have always been very happy. Our 2 cats come here and our dog did too. The staff are always friendly.
Great service and very friendly staff.
Amazing people. So polite 🥰 …
From ronnie been in the emergency hospital to seeing our own vets twice this week, everyone has been absolutely fantastic, from reception staff to all vets who have been involved in his care
Excellent wish we had of known them before maybe our other little ones would still be here would recommend all day long 🐾🐾🐾🐾🐾🐾 …
Lovely practice, very friendly and welcoming
I've been coming here for ten years with cats. Always friendly and professional
First visit and staff very friendly and helpful!

Absolutely love this vets. The staff are great, kind, caring and very helpful. The treatment for our pooch Alfie has been second to none. We joined the healthcare plan, best thing we ever did. Wouldn't use any other vets as these are the best by far. And we would highly recommend to any pet owner.
SO GRATEFUL to the ladies at this practice. They’re all amazing and go out of their way to help. Thank you for keeping our little babies safe, sound and healthy 🥰 …
Great service.  Very thorough and empathetic.  Wish we'd moved to them years ago

Cannot fault this practice everyone goes above and beyond to care for both pets and owners. A massive thankyou to Lauren that welcomed our girl into the practice just over 4 years ago when we rescued her and also gave the kindest and most compassionate of care to Bella and us and helped us say farewell in the most dignified way today. Words cannot express how grateful this was . Would highly recommend westwood both Garforth and Boston Spa to any of our friends
I have used Westwood vets for many years with my bulldog very friendly and makes my dog feel relaxed when there thank you Westwood
They made my kitten’s first vet visit as comfortable as possible. Everyone is really friendly & helpful. A great first experience!

I notice that my previous review has been removed. I made the point that in future, l will seek an independent veterinary practice that is more interested in animal care than making profit. I will never use Westwood again.

My number one choice for pet care.
The surgery is always clean bright and welcoming nothing is too much trouble for all the staff. I particularly like the separation of waiting area for cats and dogs - which shows they care how their clients are waiting without getting stressed. My Howie is extremely vocal even without seeing any other animals.
All the vets are happy to answer questions & nothing is too much trouble.
They care about our pets as if they belonged to them.. And that’s a big plus for me.
Wouldn’t go anywhere else,
100% pet friendly & good price point. Also situated in an accessible area with available free parking.
Thanks to  all at Westwood
Great care here from the moment we walk through the doors would recommend
Highly recommended. Wonderful pet care. Friendly staff.
Amazing practice with caring staff. I have been using them for 8 years and really appreciate their excellent care of my pets. The petplan offered means that costs can be budgeted each month easily.
Great friendly staff who really do seem to love animals. Also give genuine advice instead of just trying to get money out of you.
The staff are very kind and knowledgeable, they care for wildlife as well as for your pets. I took in a little mouse I had found in distress and they gently looked after her.
The staff and vets are very caring and make my old dog feel very comfortable as he’s very nervous. Highly recommend.
